records.context: A regular file is hashed end to end while it is small enough to be worth it, and above ``full_hash_limit`` from its size plus its first and last megabyte — enough to notice a rewritten database without spending minutes of I/O at the end of every processing session. A folder is fingerprinted from its file inventory: each file's relative path, size and modification time, in sorted order. Symlinks are skipped — linked files are ignored and linked subfolders are not descended into — so a folder of links fingerprints as empty.
records.label: spacr.artifacts.content_fingerprint#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A regular file is hashed end to end while it is small enough to be worth it, and above ``full_hash_limit`` from its size plus its first and last megabyte — enough to notice a rewritten database without spending minutes of I/O at the end of every run. A folder is fingerprinted from its file inventory: each file's relative path, size and modification time, in sorted order. Symlinks are skipped — linked files are ignored and linked subfolders are not descended into — so a folder of links fingerprints as empty.
records.translation: Venjuleg skrá er tætt frá upphafi til enda á meðan hún er nógu lítil til að það borgi sig, og yfir ``full_hash_limit`` út frá stærð sinni auk fyrsta og síðasta megabætis — nóg til að taka eftir endurskrifuðum gagnagrunni án þess að eyða mínútum af I/O í lok hverrar keyrslu. Fingrafar möppu er tekið af skráaskrá hennar: afstæð slóð, stærð og breytingartími hverrar skrár, í raðaðri röð. Tákntenglum er sleppt — tengdar skrár eru hunsaðar og ekki er farið niður í tengdar undirmöppur — svo mappa af tenglum fær fingrafar tómrar möppu.

records.translation: Þessi eining er hinn ásinn. Hún geymir biðröð af handahófskenndum ``(module, settings)``-verkum í hvaða röð sem er: ``Mask → Measure → Classify (CV) → Classify (ML)``, síðan sömu fjögur aftur með öðru þvermáli, síðan Mask fimmtu plötunnar.

records.context: Behaviour for unattended runs:
records.label: spacr.batch#4

records.source: Behaviour for unattended runs:
records.translation: Hegðun fyrir keyrslur án eftirlits:

records.context: **Every job is validated when it is added, not when it executes.** :func:`validate_queue` reports *all* problems at once and :func:`run_queue` refuses to start while any of them is an error.
records.label: spacr.batch#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Every job is validated when it is added, not when it runs.** :func:`validate_queue` reports *all* problems at once and :func:`run_queue` refuses to start while any of them is an error.
records.translation: **Hvert verk er sannprófað þegar því er bætt við, ekki þegar það keyrir.** :func:`validate_queue` tilkynnir *öll* vandamál í einu og :func:`run_queue` neitar að byrja á meðan eitthvert þeirra er villa.

records.context: **State is persisted after every transition, atomically.** A machine that reboots while processing the software job list is resumed with :func:`resume_queue`, not restarted. The file is written to a temp name and ``os.replace``\ d, so a crash cannot leave a truncated work list file.
records.label: spacr.batch#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **State is persisted after every transition, atomically.** A machine that reboots mid-queue is resumed with :func:`resume_queue`, not restarted. The file is written to a temp name and ``os.replace``\ d, so a crash cannot leave a truncated queue file.
records.translation: **Staðan er vistuð eftir hverja breytingu, frumeindalega.** Vél sem endurræsist í miðri biðröð er látin halda áfram með :func:`resume_queue`, ekki endurræst. Skráin er skrifuð undir tímabundnu heiti og færð á sinn stað með ``os.replace``, svo hrun getur ekki skilið eftir stytta biðraðarskrá.

records.context: **A job whose dependency failed is skipped, not executed.** Measure after a failed Mask produces a database that looks like a real result. ``skipped`` (deliberately not executed), ``failed`` and ``not_run`` (the software job list halted before reaching it) are three different things and stay that way.
records.label: spacr.batch#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A job whose dependency failed is skipped, not run.** Measure after a failed Mask produces a database that looks like a real result. ``skipped`` (deliberately not run), ``failed`` and ``not_run`` (the queue halted before reaching it) are three different things and stay that way.
records.translation: **Verki þar sem ósjálfstæði mistókst er sleppt, ekki keyrt.** Measure eftir misheppnaða Mask framleiðir gagnagrunn sem lítur út eins og raunveruleg niðurstaða. ``skipped`` (vísvitandi ekki keyrt), ``failed`` og ``not_run`` (biðröðin stöðvaðist áður en hún náði því) eru þrír ólíkir hlutir og haldast þannig.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Jobs that already succeeded are left alone. Jobs that were ``not_run`` (the queue halted before reaching them) or still ``pending`` are run. A job that was ``running`` when the machine went down is reset and run again. For Mask, Measure, and Format Converter jobs the rerun receives ``resume=True`` automatically, so their verified field checkpoints are reused instead of repeating the whole plate. Failed and skipped jobs stay as they are unless ``retry_failed`` is set.

records.source: Probabilities are read only for the orders that use them, so ``name`` and ``value`` read no scores file at all; ``uncertain`` reads ``curate_uncertainty.csv`` instead. For ``prob`` and ``easy`` a missing scores file is reported: it falls back to ``value`` with a notice naming both places it looked; a scores file that leaves some waiting fields unscored says how many; and where the scores came from is printed. Those warnings, and the one that says progress is being written back to the external tool's record beside the folder, are kept on the queue as :attr:`CurationQueue.notices` for the editor to show.
records.translation: Líkindi eru aðeins lesin fyrir raðirnar sem nota þau, svo ``name`` og ``value`` lesa enga einkunnaskrá; ``uncertain`` les ``curate_uncertainty.csv`` í staðinn. Fyrir ``prob`` og ``easy`` er tilkynnt um einkunnaskrá sem vantar: fallið er til baka á ``value`` með tilkynningu sem nefnir báða staðina sem leitað var á; einkunnaskrá sem skilur sum bíðandi myndsvið eftir án einkunnar segir hve mörg; og prentað er hvaðan einkunnirnar komu. Þessum viðvörunum, og þeirri sem segir að framvinda sé skrifuð aftur í skrá ytra verkfærisins við hlið möppunnar, er haldið á biðröðinni sem :attr:`CurationQueue.notices` svo ritillinn geti sýnt þær.

records.context: The outer ring of a microtitre laboratory microplate evaporates faster, sits at a different temperature and is handled differently from the interior. records.source: Statistical choices
records.translation: Tölfræðileg val

records.context: **Rank tests, not t-tests.** Per-microplate sample position aggregates of object measurements are routinely skewed and heavy-tailed — a microplate sample position with three enormous cells is not a normal deviate. The ring comparison is a two-sided Mann-Whitney U; the gradient test is Spearman. Neither assumes a shape.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Rank tests, not t-tests.** Per-well aggregates of object measurements are routinely skewed and heavy-tailed — a well with three enormous cells is not a normal deviate. The ring comparison is a two-sided Mann-Whitney U; the gradient test is Spearman. Neither assumes a shape.
records.translation: **Raðpróf, ekki t-próf.** Samantektir á mælingum hluta fyrir hvern brunn eru reglulega skekktar og með þunga hala — brunnur með þremur risastórum frumum er ekki normalt frávik. Hringsamanburðurinn er tvíhliða Mann-Whitney U; hallaprófið er Spearman. Hvorugt gerir ráð fyrir lögun.

records.context: **Effect size leads, p-value follows.** With 384 microplate sample positions, almost any systematic drift clears p < 0.05; that fact carries no information. Every comparison therefore reports the median difference, the difference as a percentage of the interior median, *and* Cliff's delta — a rank-based standardised effect in [-1, 1] read straight off the same U statistic (``δ = 2U/n₁n₂ − 1``). Detection requires both a small p **and** an effect size above :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_EFFECT`, so a significant but 0.4 % difference is not reported as an edge effect.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Effect size leads, p-value follows.** With 384 wells, almost any systematic drift clears p < 0.05; that fact carries no information. Every comparison therefore reports the median difference, the difference as a percentage of the interior median, *and* Cliff's delta — a rank-based standardised effect in [-1, 1] read straight off the same U statistic (``δ = 2U/n₁n₂ − 1``). Detection requires both a small p **and** an effect size above :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_EFFECT`, so a significant but 0.4 % difference is not reported as an edge effect.
records.translation: **Áhrifastærð fyrst, p-gildi á eftir.** Með 384 brunnum kemst nánast hvaða kerfisbundna rek sem er undir p < 0.05; sú staðreynd ber engar upplýsingar. Hver samanburður tilkynnir því mismun miðgilda, mismuninn sem hlutfall af miðgildi innri hlutans, *og* Cliff's delta — staðlaða raðbundna áhrifastærð á [-1, 1] sem lesin er beint af sama U-tölfræðigildinu (``δ = 2U/n₁n₂ − 1``). Greining krefst bæði lítils p **og** áhrifastærðar yfir :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_EFFECT`, svo marktækur en 0.4 % mismunur er ekki tilkynntur sem jaðaráhrif.

records.context: **Evaporation is not a step function.** The profile walks inward ring by ring (outermost = ring 0), comparing each against the laboratory microplate core, so a gradient that reaches two microplate sample positions in is visible instead of being averaged into "the interior".
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Evaporation is not a step function.** The profile walks inward ring by ring (outermost = ring 0), comparing each against the plate core, so a gradient that reaches two wells in is visible instead of being averaged into "the interior".
records.translation: **Uppgufun er ekki þrepafall.** Sniðið gengur inn á við hring fyrir hring (ystur = hringur 0) og ber hvern saman við kjarna plötunnar, svo halli sem nær tvo brunna inn er sýnilegur í stað þess að vera meðaltalaður inn í "the interior".

records.context: **A gradient is not an edge effect.** An incubator or laboratory microplate-reader gradient runs *across* the laboratory microplate; evaporation runs *around* it. A linear column gradient leaves the outer ring with the same median as the interior (it collects both the high and the low end), so the ring test stays quiet while Spearman on the column index fires. Both are computed, both are reported, and :attr:`EdgeEffectReport.dominant` names which one better explains the laboratory microplate.
records.label: spacr.plate_qc#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A gradient is not an edge effect.** An incubator or plate-reader gradient runs *across* the plate; evaporation runs *around* it. A linear column gradient leaves the outer ring with the same median as the interior (it collects both the high and the low end), so the ring test stays quiet while Spearman on the column index fires. Both are computed, both are reported, and :attr:`EdgeEffectReport.dominant` names which one better explains the plate.
records.translation: **Halli er ekki jaðaráhrif.** Halli frá hitaskáp eða plötulesara liggur *þvert yfir* plötuna; uppgufun liggur *umhverfis* hana. Línulegur dálkahalli skilur ytri hringinn eftir með sama miðgildi og innri hlutinn (hann safnar bæði háa og lága endanum), svo hringprófið þegir á meðan Spearman á dálkvísinum svarar. Hvort tveggja er reiknað, hvort tveggja er tilkynnt, og :attr:`EdgeEffectReport.dominant` nefnir hvort skýrir plötuna betur.

records.context: **Existing rows are removed prior to inserting replacements.** The measurement workflow calls ``to_sql(if_exists='append')`` to append rows. Measuring a field again would create a duplicate of each object rather than replace the old rows. This makes ``count_cell`` twice as large and biases the mean for each well. Removing old rows prior to another measurement makes the operation safe to repeat.
records.label: spacr.resume.clear_field_rows#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **This is the delete-before-insert.** Measure appends (``to_sql(if_exists='append')``), so re-running a field that already wrote rows adds a second copy of every object rather than replacing the first. Downstream, ``count_cell`` doubles, per-well means are computed over the doubled population, and nothing in the artifact says so. Calling this immediately before re-measuring a field is what makes a resume idempotent.
records.translation: **Þetta er eyðing-fyrir-innsetningu.** Measure bætir við (``to_sql(if_exists='append')``), svo endurkeyrsla myndsviðs sem þegar skrifaði línur bætir við öðru afriti af hverjum hlut í stað þess að skipta út því fyrra. Síðar í ferlinu tvöfaldast ``count_cell``, meðaltöl á hvern brunn eru reiknuð yfir tvöfaldaða þýðið, og ekkert í afurðinni segir frá því. Að kalla á þetta strax áður en myndsvið er mælt aftur er það sem gerir endurræsingu sjálfgilda.

records.context: **Only rows measure itself wrote.** Owned by name is not owned in fact: in a project built by ``foreign.run_import`` the rows in ``cell`` are the import's, sitting under spaCR's own metadata columns in a table that is on the allow-list. Every DELETE is therefore narrowed by :func:`measure_rows_clause`, which is true only for rows holding a value in a column the importer never wrote. Clearing a field takes measure's rows for that field and leaves the import's — in the same table, in the same statement.

Every DELETE is therefore narrowed by :func:`measure_rows_clause`, which is true only for rows holding a value in a column the importer never wrote. Clearing a field takes measure's rows for that field and leaves the import's — in the same table, in the same statement.
records.translation: **Aðeins línur sem measure skrifaði sjálft.** Eign eftir heiti er ekki eign í raun: í verkefni sem ``foreign.run_import`` byggði eru línurnar í ``cell`` frá innflutningnum, undir eigin lýsigagnadálkum spaCR í töflu sem er á leyfislistanum. Hreinsun myndsviðs tekur línur measure fyrir það myndsvið og skilur línur innflutningsins eftir — í sömu töflu, í sömu skipun.

records.context: "Present" means present in a row **measure wrote**. Rows a foreign import copied into a canonical table do not count: a project built purely by import has ``cell`` as its only microscope field of view table and a row in it for every microscope field of view, so counting them would report the whole laboratory microplate as measured, ``measure_crop`` would execute nothing, and the imported numbers would stand as spaCR's output. records.context: The rank is defined here, once, so both sides of a diff are ranked the same way: rows are sorted by **descending absolute score**, ties broken by structured-data name. Absolute, because a screening experiment's strongest hit is its largest effect in either direction and ranking a strong protective hit below a weak sensitising one would report rank churn that is an artefact of the sort. Absolute, because a screen's strongest hit is its largest effect in either direction and ranking a strong protective hit below a weak sensitising one would report rank churn that is an artefact of the sort. When no score column can be found the file's own row order is kept and :attr:`HitList.score_column` is empty, so a caller can tell a real ranking from a preserved one.
